insights.summary: Initial setup feedback points to unclear sequencing and guidance, invitation-link expiry, and setup progress/settings that may not persist.
insights.pm_recommendation: Test clearer step ordering and role/permission guidance, a next-action welcome screen, and persistence/resume behavior; review invitation-link expiry handling with admins.

insights.summary: Feedback describes overlapping email and push alerts, repeated or post-resolution reminders, and limited control over notification priority or channel.
insights.pm_recommendation: Prototype per-channel preferences, priority muting, digest options, and suppression of reminders after resolution; validate preferences and reminder rules with users.

insights.summary: Users report difficulty finding reports and exports, accessing useful breakdowns/filters, interpreting charts, and comparing team metrics.
insights.pm_recommendation: Test report navigation and export discoverability alongside category/region filters, chart explanations, and cross-team comparison workflows.

insights.summary: Billing statements and notices are described as lacking clear detail about add-ons, seat-count effects, overages, renewal charges, taxes, or discounts.
insights.pm_recommendation: Evaluate invoice line-item clarity and pre-renewal notices that explain seat counts, overages, add-ons, taxes, discounts, and expected charges.

insights.summary: Integration feedback describes missing, duplicated, stale, or stopped data, alongside limited error visibility and retry guidance.
insights.pm_recommendation: Investigate sync freshness and reconnect behavior; test user-facing status/error details and actionable retry guidance, while validating duplicate prevention.

insights.summary: Mobile feedback identifies screen-layout constraints and accessibility issues involving text size, screen-reader field cues, large-text stability, and keyboard navigation.
insights.pm_recommendation: Run mobile accessibility checks across viewport sizes, large-text settings, screen readers, and keyboard paths; validate fixes with users relying on these features.
